authority.shared: server-authoritative only after separately approved enablement
authority.offline: reject cloud writes; controlled isolated single-device fallback, never auto-merge

submit_result.retry: identical authenticated retry returns original outcome
submit_result.validation: best-of 3 regular, best-of 5 championship final; 11-point win-by-two; match participant must win
submit_result.outcome: atomic match result, eligible advancement, version increments, audit record

corrections.downstream_resolved: reject until explicit audited dependent-result remediation

snapshot.public: allowlisted projection only; no complete organizer state

realtime: notification with event revision; refetch authorized snapshot; never broadcast private player row
recovery: no automatic offline queue or JSON upload into active cloud event; manual organizer-authorized reconciliation only
